**Prerequisites:** [M05 Mathematics for Data Science (R)](m05.qmd), [M01 Python](m01.qmd) · **GPU:** optional

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | Tensor Mathematics | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Tensor operations and linear algebra foundations for DL. |
| 02 | The Artificial Neuron | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Neuron model, weights, bias, and activation intuition. |
| 03 | Activation Functions | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Common activations and their properties. |
| 04 | Multi-Layer Perceptrons | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | MLP architectures and feedforward networks. |
| 05 | Loss Functions | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Loss choices and their effects on training. |
| 06 | Gradient Descent | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Optimization basics and learning dynamics. |
| 07 | Backpropagation | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Backprop algorithm and computational graph derivatives. |
| 08 | Auto-Differentiation | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Autograd mechanics and practical tips. |
| 09 | Batches & DataLoaders | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Mini-batching, loaders, and efficient data pipelines. |
| 10 | Advanced Optimizers | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Adam, RMSProp, and optimizer variants. |
| 11 | The Training Loop | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Epochs, steps, evaluation, and debugging loops. |
| 12 | Gradient Instability | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Vanishing/exploding gradients and remedies. |
| 13 | Weight Initialization | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Initialization schemes and their impact. |
| 14 | Regularization: Dropout | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Dropout and other regularization techniques. |
| 15 | Normalization Layers | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | BatchNorm, LayerNorm and training stability. |
| 16 | Learning Rate Scheduling | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Schedulers, warmup, and cyclic strategies. |
| 17 | Residual Connections & Modern Building Blocks |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 18 | Handling Imbalanced Data | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Techniques for class imbalance in DL. |
| 19 | Deep Learning Diagnostics | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Training diagnostics, visualizations, and fixes. |
| 20 | Hardware Acceleration | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | GPUs, mixed precision, and performance tips. |
| 21 | torch.compile & Mixed Precision (bf16, FP8) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 22 | Callbacks & Checkpointing | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Checkpoints, callbacks, and training utilities. |
| 23 | Training with Lightning & Accelerate |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 24 | Multi-Task Architectures | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Multi-head and multi-task model designs. |
| 25 | Representation Learning & World Models (Contrastive, Masked, JEPA) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 26 | Scaling Laws |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
